---
applyTo: "app/**"
---
Use `skills/code-app-development/SKILL.md` and `skills/command-concurrency/SKILL.md`. TypeScript strict mode, accessible components, generated Power Apps services behind domain adapters, tests for domain logic, no secrets or environment-specific constants.

The Code App lives in `app/`, outside the `src/` solution root, so its build output is never packaged into the Dataverse solution.
